title: Chrono24 Watch Scraper
description: Scrape Chrono24 watch listings from either a search URL or a keyword. Provide one search mode; the URL takes priority if both are supplied.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword used when no URL is provided.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of watch listings to save.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of paginated result pages to request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential Apify Proxy is enabled by default. You can change the proxy groups or disable the proxy.
